correctness.rationale: The affine branches and invariant Lebesgue measure are verified against arXiv:1811.01009 §1.3. Ternary-digit independence gives the exact conditional stable-coordinate identity; the independent binary-digit Koopman recurrence yields a unique bounded resolvent and an algebraic generating function. Both square-root singularities are analyzed, with cancellation at t=2/3, no other competing singularities and explicit signed amplitudes. The complete analytic proof establishes all n, while 6 direct exact cube integrals, 17 formal series coefficients and numerical asymptotic tests independently support it. Boundary points are null sets.
